name: configure_developer
description: One-time (or update) developer commissioning for this plugin workspace: records the email, display name, and optional public GitHub repo URL that generate_plugin_scaffold stamps into every server_entry.json's developer/author fields. Call this first if generate_plugin_scaffold's error says no developer config exists yet for this plugin_output_root. The email given must match this session's own authenticated identity when one is known -- refuses on an actual mismatch. Never invent or guess the developer's email/name; ask the person directly.

email.description: The developer's email address. Must match this session's own authenticated identity, when one is known, or the call is refused.

name.description: The developer's display name -- stamped into every generated server_entry.json's 'author' field.

github_url.description: Optional public GitHub repository URL for this developer. Omit if they don't have one or it isn't public.

default_run_as.description: Optional OS account every generated plugin's server_entry.json uses as its 'runAs' fallback, unless a given plugin's own server_entry.runAs overrides it. Omit to keep the tool's own built-in default ('admin').
